# Keep imported education dates attached to the right school

## What & Why
Reviewed education entries currently preserve credentials and supporting details, but imported dates are not carried through as structured values. Keeping dates paired with each school makes the saved resume complete and prevents dates from being lost during review.

## Done looks like
- Common education date formats are parsed into each imported education entry.
- Accepted and edited entries retain their own dates and provenance.
- Rejected entries do not add dates or other structured education data.
